scenario_suite.canonicalization: Sort scenario filenames bytewise; hash UTF-8(relative path + NUL + exact file bytes) for each file in order.

matrix.clean_run_rule: Every run gets a fresh subject snapshot and a fresh agent session; no conversation, history, cache, or workspace reuse may carry task knowledge across runs.

subject_isolation.control_plane: The evaluator reads scenarios and protocol from the control checkout.
subject_isolation.subject_context: The subject checkout contains the selected source SHA but must not contain evals/coding-agent/**.
subject_isolation.agent_access: Do not grant the agent an additional directory containing the evaluator control plane.
